verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' documented API lets an agent read card and bank statements and update and reconcile transactions. It also exposes CRUD for categories, cost centers and suppliers, plus receipt linking, so pulling transactions and writing classifications back is supported over server-to-server OAuth, with agent-friendly llms.txt and Markdown docs. However, nothing shows a filter for uncoded transactions, policy-flag fields, a review or approval state for agent-pushed coding, or an MCP server. missing for 10: filtering for uncoded transactions, policy flag/violation fields, a review queue for pushed coding, an MCP server, a published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
